rules.rule: Marriage-migrant PR. Household income (the applicant plus family sharing a livelihood) must be at least 1x per-capita GNI. Alternatively, household net assets must be at least the median level. The same income and asset alternatives appear in all three manual cases: still married, raising the couple's child, or marriage ended without the applicant's fault.
rules.amount: 1x GNI = KRW 52,416,000 (applications 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31); assets: median household net assets (KRW figure not confirmed, see the assets rule)
rules.conditions: 2+ years on F-6 (F-6-1, F-6-2 or F-6-3)
rules.effect: Income test met, or replaced by the asset route
rules.stacks: Income and assets cannot be added together (common F-5 rule)
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 2. 결혼이민자(F-5-2) › 2) 제출 서류, transcribed in data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-2 (onlyKo strings)
rules.quote: 본인 또는 생계를 같이하는 가족의 소득금액증명 (일인당 국민총소득 이상의 소득금액) / 본인과 생계를 같이하는 가족 모두의 자산 증빙서류 (중위수준 이상의 가계 자산)

rules.rule: 2+ years of stay in Korea as the spouse of a Korean citizen. Time on F-6-1, F-6-2 and F-6-3 counts.
rules.conditions: Married and living together, OR raising the couple's child in Korea, OR marriage ended by death, disappearance or another cause that was not the applicant's fault
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 제2호; KIS manual case list in data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-2
rules.quote: 국민 또는 영주자격(F-5)을 가진 사람의 배우자 또는 미성년 자녀로서 대한민국에 2년 이상 체류하고 있는 사람

rules.rule: Basic knowledge (기본소양): either completion of the KIIP permanent-residence or naturalization track (= level 5), or a pass of 60+ points on the KIPRAT/KINAT comprehensive test.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-2 (manual 2026.9.18 › 32 › 2.), docs kiipCompletionCertificatePrOrNaturalizat / kipratOrKinatPassCertificate
rules.quote: (사회통합프로그램 이수) / (종합평가 60점 이상)

rules.rule: The manual's own F-5-2 document list confirms that there are applicants who qualify for a relaxation or exemption of the requirements. They prove their ground with extra documents. The manual extract in the repo does not state the criteria.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-2 > doc otherDocumentsTheOfficeRequiresEGProofOf (manual 2026.9.18)
rules.quote: 그 밖에 심사에 필요하다고 청장 등이 인정한 서류(요건 완화･면제 대상자의 해당 사유 소명 자료 등) 등

rules.rule: Leads put these groups at 80% of the standard (a 20% relaxation of the income or asset amount), NOT a full exemption: (1) pregnant with the Korean spouse's child, miscarriage included; (2) has had infertility treatment in order to have a child (one source: for 1+ year); (3) raising a minor child of the Korean spouse; (4) has lived with and supported the Korean spouse's parents (one source: lineal family) for 1+ year; (5) aged 60+. Proof: a medical certificate of the pregnancy or infertility treatment, the birth certificate, and proof of child-rearing or support.
rules.amount: 0.8x GNI = KRW 41,932,800 household income (or 80% of the median asset figure)
rules.conditions: Any one of the five grounds
rules.stacks: Not stated. Single factor, so treat as not stacking
rules.source: Practitioner leads: https://immikorea.com/f-6-%EA%B2%B0%ED%98%BC-%EB%B9%84%EC%9E%90-%EC%86%8C%EC%A7%80%EC%9E%90%EC%9D%98-f-5-%EC%98%81%EC%A3%BC%EA%B6%8C-%EC%8B%A0%EC%B2%AD/ ; https://yoonhjs.com/f-type-visa-%EB%8F%99%EA%B1%B0%EA%B1%B0%EC%A3%BC%EB%8F%99%EB%B0%98%EC%98%81%EC%A3%BC%EA%B2%B0%ED%98%BC/?mod=document&uid=422 ; SBS news https://news.sbs.co.kr/news/endPage.do?news_id=N1008007410 (WebSearch extracts)
rules.quote: 국민의 자녀를 임신한 사람 (유산 포함) / 자녀 출산을 위해 불임 시술을 받았을시 / 배우자 부모를 1년 이상 부양 및 동거시 / 만 60세 이상인 경우 / 원칙적 기준의 80% 적용 / 20% 범위 내에서 기준금액 (소득, 자산)을 완화할 수 있다 / 한국인 배우자의 자녀를 임신한 경우나 1년 이상 불임치료를 받는 경우, 배우자의 직계가족을 1년 이상 부양하며 동거하는 경우에도 20% 범위 내에서 완화됩니다

rules.rule: I found no source saying that pregnancy, infertility treatment, raising a minor child or supporting the spouse's parents FULLY exempts the applicant from the income test. Every lead lists these grounds as 80% relaxations. The only full exemptions found concern other things: the F-6-1 VISA sponsor-income waiver when the couple has a child, and the KIIP exemption at 60+. Treat 'full exemption' as unsupported.
rules.effect: No full income exemption should be modelled for F-5-2 on current evidence
rules.source: Same leads as the 80% rule; data/visadocs.yaml F-6-1 lists (소득요건 적용 면제 ① 부부 사이에 태어난 자녀가 있는 경우), which concern the F-6-1 visa and not F-5-2
rules.quote: 소득요건 적용 면제 ① 부부 사이에 태어난 자녀가 있는 경우 (F-6-1 sponsor rule, not F-5-2)

rules.rule: Tiered child-rearing reduction, reported by one search extract only. With 2 to 5 years of stay and 1 child: 20% off. With 2 children: 30% off. With 10+ years of stay and 2 children: 50% off. This is unconfirmed and conflicts with the flat 80% leads. Possibly an older or garbled version of the manual's residence-length tiers.
rules.conditions: Raising the couple's child(ren); length of stay 2-5 years or 10+ years
rules.source: WebSearch extract attributed to one of news.sbs.co.kr N1008007410, hanvisa.net, immikorea.com (attribution unclear)
rules.quote: 국내 체류기간 2년에서 5년 사이에 자녀 1명을 양육하면 기준금액의 20%가 경감되고, 자녀 2명이면 30%가 경감됩니다. 또 체류기간 10년 이상에 자녀 2명이면 무려 50%까지 경감됩니다

rules.rule: Where household income is combined, the applicant's own share must be at least 50% of the threshold. This floor does NOT apply when the applicant is raising a minor child (or is a minor child).
rules.amount: Own income >= KRW 26,208,000 (50% of 1x), or >= 20,966,400 under the 80% relaxation; no own floor when raising a minor child
rules.effect: Own-share floor, waived for parents of minor children
rules.source: https://lawfirm-us.com/visa-income/ ; k-labor.co.kr relay of the KIS manual (research_R3)
rules.quote: 영주(F-5)는 가족 합산이 되지만 "신청인 본인 몫이 기준액의 50% 이상"이라는 벽이 있습니다 ... 미성년 자녀 양육 시 예외 / 신청인이 미성년자녀를 양육하는 경우와 미성년 자녀인 경우 제외

rules.rule: Marriage migrants aged 60+ are reportedly exempt from the KIIP/basic-knowledge requirement.
rules.stacks: Independent of the income relaxation (60+ is also in the 80% list)
rules.source: Practitioner lead (WebSearch extract, immikorea.com / yoonhjs.com results)
rules.quote: 면제 대상자 - 결혼 이민자로 만 60세 이상인 경우

rules.rule: The asset alternative is household net assets at or above the MEDIAN (중위수준) of the 가계금융복지조사. The 2025 survey's official median was not found. A secondary site gives about KRW 260M (55% of the KRW 471.44M average). An old guide gives KRW 255M (2018 basis).
rules.amount: About KRW 260,000,000 (unconfirmed); the average is KRW 471,440,000 for comparison
rules.conditions: Asset route instead of income; assets held 6+ months, debts deducted per the credit report
rules.source: Asset site via WebSearch (moneynestlab.com / asiatop.co.kr extracts); average from the 2025 가계금융복지조사 (newsis NISX20251204_0003428382)
rules.quote: 중위 순자산 2.6억이며 평균의 55% / 가구당 순자산은 4억7144만원으로 전년 대비 5.0% 증가

rules.rule: Minor foreign child of a Korean citizen. No income/livelihood test. 2+ years on F-2 (F-2-2), and still a minor (under 19) when applying.
rules.conditions: Minor at application; 2+ years in Korea
rules.source: Manual 2026.9.18 › 32 › 2. 라. (data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-3: no income or asset documents); lead yoonhjs uid=421/422 (WebSearch extract)
rules.quote: F-5-3 국민의 미성년 자녀. 소득요건은 면제.

rules.rule: Basic knowledge IS required: KIIP completion or 60+ on the comprehensive test. Exempt: those who completed regular Korean schooling; one lead also names children under 15.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-3 (manual 2026.9.18); yoonhjs lead (WebSearch extract)
rules.quote: (사회통합프로그램 이수) / (종합평가 60점 이상) / 기본소양 면제: (정규교육 과정 이수자) / 면제대상은 만 15세 미만이거나 초·중 2년 이수자

rules.rule: Spouse or minor child of a general PR holder. Income of 1x GNI, which the household may combine (spouse and cohabiting parents or children) as long as the applicant's own share is at least 50%. The manual's document list also carries the asset route (자산보유 기준). Its multiple is not stated: probably 1x the average.
rules.stacks: Income and assets cannot be added together
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-4 (manual 2026.9.18 › 32 › 3. 〔F-5-4〕 다. 제출서류); practitioner leads (visaskorea.com/f-5-4-docs-en, inblog.ai/kvisa/kv-113, WebSearch extract)
rules.quote: 소득요건 : GNI 1배 충족 (본인, 배우자, 또는 생계를 같이 하는 동거가족 (부모,자녀) 소득합산 가능. 반드시 본인의 소득이 50% 이상이 되어야 함.) / 자산보유 기준

rules.rule: 2+ years in Korea on F-2-3. Absences of 3+ months are excluded from the count. No text requires the F-5 principal to have held F-5 for any period.
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 제2호; lead (WebSearch extract)
rules.quote: 체류요건 : F-2-3 소지 후 2년 경과 (3개월 이상 출국시 거주 기간 제외)

rules.rule: Basic knowledge: KIIP 5 or 60+ on the KIPRAT/KINAT test. Exempt: minors under 15, and minors 15+ enrolled in regular education.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-4 > proofOfBasicKoreanAbility note (manual 2026.9.18)
rules.quote: 기본소양 요건 입증서류 (Exempt: minors under 15, and minors 15+ enrolled in regular education)

rules.rule: Large investor. US$500K invested under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, with 5+ Korean nationals employed (evidence covering 6+ continuous months). No income test on the investor, no basic-knowledge test (no such documents in the list), and no residence period.
rules.conditions: Applicant personally is the FIPA 외국인투자가
rules.effect: Direct PR (change of status, or a PR visa at the consul's discretion)
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 제3호; data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-5
rules.quote: 「외국인투자 촉진법」에 따라 미화 50만 달러를 투자한 외국인투자가로서 5명 이상의 국민을 고용하고 있는 사람

rules.rule: No official text uses the code 'F-5-6R'. The MOJ describes the regional overseas-Korean (F-4-R) PR benefit as a relaxation of the livelihood requirement when changing to F-5. A practitioner article ties it explicitly to F-5-6. So the PR status is most likely F-5-6 on relaxed terms, not a separate code.
rules.conditions: F-4-R holder living in the recommended depopulating area
rules.effect: F-5-6 with a relaxed livelihood requirement
rules.source: MOJ press release 2025-12-31 「지역체류지원과」「동포체류통합과」 신설 (immigration.go.kr/bbs/immigration/214/488962/download.do, WebSearch extract); https://www.lawwin.co.kr/news/2759
rules.quote: 인구감소지역에 2년 이상 실제 거주하는 조건으로 F-4 체류자격 변경, 취업활동 제한 완화, 영주(F-5-6)의 생계유지능력 요건 완화

rules.rule: F-4-R route to PR, from leads: 4+ years of continuous residence in the recommended region while keeping F-4-R (2 years for those who changed under the existing-resident track). The income requirement is relaxed to 70% of GNI. No KIIP requirement is mentioned, and the F-5-6 list has no basic-knowledge document.
rules.conditions: F-4-R, 4 years in the region (2 for existing residents)
rules.stacks: Unknown whether it stacks with the F-5-6 volunteer/Korean-skill cuts (floor 0.6 for F-5-6)
rules.source: https://yoonhjs.com/korea_visa/korea_c38-f4-h5-h2/ (지역특화형 재외동포 F-4-R pages); https://hanvisa.net (F-4-R 2026 guide), WebSearch extracts
rules.quote: 지역특화동포(F-4-R)로 자격 변경 후 4년 이상 계속 추천지역에 거주하며 자격을 유지한 사람 ... 기존 거주자 요건으로 자격을 변경한 경우에는 2년 기준 / 소득 기준을 1인당 국민총소득(GNI)의 70%로 완화

rules.rule: An ethnic Korean who meets a Nationality Act acquisition route (general naturalization art. 5 except item 1-2; simplified art. 6; special naturalization; restoration art. 9). For the general and simplified routes, proof of KIIP (naturalization/PR track) or KIPRAT and proof of ability to support the family are required. For restoration and special-naturalization cases neither is required. The livelihood standard is the naturalization one, not a GNI multiple. The decree does not require F-4 status.
rules.amount: Naturalization livelihood standard (not GNI-based; amount not established)
rules.effect: PR without the F-5-6 income test
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-7 (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 36 › 5. › F-5-7); 별표 1의3 제5호
rules.quote: Not required for nationality-restoration or special-naturalization cases (kiipCompletionCertificatePrTrackOrKiprat; proofOfAbilityToSupportTheFamily) / 「국적법」에 따른 국적 취득 요건을 갖춘 사람

rules.rule: F-5-14 is still open after the 2026-02-12 H-2/F-4 merger. The MOJ's February 2026 overseas-Korean manual keeps the F-5-14 procedure and an annex listing qualifying licences. It applies to H-2 holders and to those who changed to F-4, with 4+ years continuously at the same employer in manufacturing, agriculture/livestock, fishing, or as caregivers or domestic helpers. A change within 3 months to the same industry for an unavoidable reason (unpaid wages, closure) counts as continuous.
rules.conditions: Ethnic Korean on H-2 or F-4 (converted from H-2) in the listed sectors
rules.source: 법무부 「알기쉬운 외국국적동포 업무 매뉴얼」 2026. 2. (PDF at jincci.korcham.net), WebSearch extracts; 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 제12호
rules.quote: '26. 2. 12.부터 방문취업(H-2)과 재외동포(F-4)로 이원화된 동포체류자격을 재외동포(F-4) 자격으로 통합 / 【별첨9】영주(F-5-14) 부여 자격 종목 및 등급 / 제조업·농축산업·어업·간병인·가사보조인으로 동일 업체에서 4년 이상 계속 근무 / 소속업체의 임금체불, 휴폐업 등 불가피한 사유로 3개월 이내 동일 업종으로 근무처를 변경한 경우에는 계속 취업으로 인정

rules.rule: Either a listed technical/skill qualification (annex 9) OR the applicant's own annual income of at least 70% of GNI. Only own income counts. One lead says 1x GNI (unresolved).
rules.amount: 0.7x GNI = KRW 36,691,200 (own); 1x = 52,416,000 per a minority lead
rules.conditions: In addition to 4 years with the same employer
rules.effect: Livelihood requirement, satisfied by a qualification instead
rules.source: yoonhjs.com 방문취업 H-2 → F5-14 page and hanvisa.net F-5-14 page (practitioner, via research_R3 and this round's extracts)
rules.quote: 연간 소득이 전년도 GNI의 70% 이상 (본인 소득만 인정) / 방문취업 4년 이상 자격소지자(F-5-14) ... 소득 기준이 GNI의 70% 이상으로 완화

rules.rule: Lead only, relevant to former H-2 workers now on F-4. One extract lists 'H-2 holders of 4+ years' alongside KIIP 5 completers and Korean school or degree graduates as getting the 70%-of-GNI income standard. That would make 70% available on F-5-6 to former long-serving H-2 holders as well.
rules.stacks: Same tier as koreanSkill (0.7); unknown if it reaches 0.6 with volunteering
rules.source: WebSearch extract (secondary guide, results incl. hanvisa.net / yoonhjs.com)
rules.quote: 방문취업 4년 이상 자격소지자(F-5-14), 사회통합프로그램 5단계 이수자, 국내 초·중·고 졸업자 또는 국내 학사 이상 학위 취득자는 소득 기준이 GNI의 70% 이상으로 완화

rules.rule: Tourism/resort investor. PR once the F-2 차목 (F-2-8) investment has been kept continuously for 5+ years. No income test and no basic-knowledge test: the manual list has neither, and the letter of guarantee is waived for F-5-17/19/21/22/23.
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 제14호; data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-17 (manual 2026.9.18 › 32 › 12.)
rules.quote: 별표 1의2 중 24. 거주(F-2) 차목에 해당하는 체류자격을 받은 후 5년 이상 계속 투자 상태를 유지하고 있는 사람 … 과 그 배우자 및 자녀

rules.rule: The investor's spouse and the children who meet MOJ's requirements (unmarried) get F-5 together with the F-5-17 investor. The 5-year condition is on the investor's investment, not on the family member's own years. No income or KIIP test.
rules.source: 별표 1의3 제14호; data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-19 (미혼 자녀만 해당)
rules.quote: … 사람과 그 배우자 및 자녀(법무부장관이 정하는 요건을 갖춘 자녀만 해당한다) / 미혼 자녀만 해당

rules.rule: Public-interest investor: PR after keeping the F-2-12 investment (₩1.5bn) for 5 years. No income or KIIP test.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2023-319호; immigration.go.kr 공익사업 투자이민제; data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-21
rules.quote: 일반 15억 원 이상 → 거주(F-2), 5년 투자 유지 시 영주(F-5)

rules.rule: Spouse and unmarried children of the F-5-21 investor follow the investor. No own residence period, income or KIIP test.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2023-319호; data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-22 (미혼 자녀만 해당)
rules.quote: …와 그 배우자 및 미혼자녀

rules.rule: Conditional large investor: ₩3bn+ in the principal-guaranteed, non-interest public-interest product, on condition of keeping it 5 years. A withdrawal cancels the PR. Covers the spouse and unmarried children. No residence period, income or KIIP test.
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 제16호; 법무부고시 제2023-319호 Ⅲ; data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-25
rules.quote: 5년 이상 투자 상태를 유지할 것을 조건으로 법무부장관이 정하여 고시하는 금액 이상을 투자한 사람과 그 배우자 및 자녀 / 원금보장·무이자형에 30억 원 이상

rules.rule: Recognised refugee: 2+ years on F-2-4. Income of at least 1x GNI (the spouse's and parents' income can be combined) OR household assets at or above the median. KIIP completion or the PR comprehensive test is required.
rules.amount: 1x GNI = KRW 52,416,000 household, or median household net assets
rules.source: 서울행정법원 2022구단72871 (2024-07-12) summary (casenote.kr, via research_R1); immikorea.com/en/f-5-27-permanent-residence-refugee-admissions/ and visaskorea.com/f-5-27-visa-docs/ (WebSearch extracts)

openQuestions: F-5-2: the official MOJ/KIS text of the livelihood relaxation. Is it a flat 80% for pregnancy (incl. miscarriage), infertility treatment, raising a minor child, supporting the spouse's parents or lineal family 1+ year, and age 60+? Or is there the tiered child-rearing scheme one extract reports (20% off with 1 child at 2-5 years of stay, 30% with 2 children, 50% at 10+ years with 2 children)? Is anything a FULL exemption? (The reported 'full exemption' was not found in any source.)
F-5-2 / F-5-27: the KRW median household net assets (가계금융복지조사 중위값) KIS applies in 2026. A secondary site gives about ₩260M for the 2025 survey; the official KOSIS value was not found.

F-5-6R: does KIS use the code F-5-6R at all? MOJ text speaks only of F-5 / F-5-6 with a relaxed livelihood requirement. Is the period 4 years (2 for existing residents, per yoonhjs 2024) or the 2-year residence condition in the 2025-12-31 press release and on lawwin? Is the 70% household or own income? Is there any KIIP requirement?

F-5-14: 70% vs 100% of GNI (own income only?); the qualification list (annex 9 of the 2026.2 동포 manual); whether a basic-knowledge (KIIP) requirement applies; whether H-2 holders still on H-2 (pre-merger visas) and F-4 converts are treated alike.
F-5-6: does the 70% Korean-proficiency tier also cover F-4 holders with 4+ years of prior H-2 (one extract lists '방문취업 4년 이상 자격소지자(F-5-14)' in the 70% group)?
F-5-4, F-5-28, F-5-29, F-5-S2: the asset multiple for the asset route (1x average assumed); the income multiple for F-5-28/F-5-29 (1x assumed, no text found); the F-5-29 residence period.
F-5-T1: is there any 2-year variant for family who join after the principal's F-5-T? Only 3 years is sourced.
F-5-7: the Nationality Act livelihood standard applied to F-5-7 applicants on the general/simplified routes (an amount or asset figure), not established here.
Does the F-5-6 80% volunteering reduction extend to F-5-2/F-5-4 (a volunteer-centre notice says only '영주(F-5)')?
notes:
Method: I read data/visamap.yaml (F-5 nodes and incomeCuts), visa-map-audit/tools/graph.txt and money.txt, assets/js/visa/rules.js (incomeFor), the round-2 research JSONs and findings.md. I tabulated which F-5 document lists in data/visadocs.yaml carry income, asset and basic-knowledge documents. Then I ran exactly 20 WebSearch calls (the allowance); WebFetch was not used. All web quotes are WebSearch extracts. Practitioner pages are marked primary=false.

Document-list evidence (manual 2026.9.18, via visadocs):
- Income + asset + basic-knowledge documents: F-5-2, F-5-4, F-5-18, F-5-28, F-5-29, F-5-S2.
- Basic knowledge only, no income: F-5-3, F-5-7.
- No income or Korean documents: F-5-17, F-5-19, F-5-21, F-5-22, F-5-25, F-5-T1.
- F-5-5: employment documents only.
- No visadocs target: F-5-14, F-5-6R, F-5-27.

Key conclusions:
(1) F-5-2: the base rule is primary (household 1x GNI = ₩52,416,000, or median household assets; KIIP or 60-point test; 2 years on F-6), and the manual confirms that relaxation/exemption groups exist. The pregnancy, infertility, minor-child, parent-support and 60+ grounds are 80% relaxations (₩41,932,800) in every lead, NOT full exemptions. A tiered 20/30/50% child-rearing scheme appears in one extract only.
(2) F-5-6R is not attested as a code. Official MOJ text describes a relaxed F-5-6 livelihood test for F-4-R holders. The data's F-5-6R node lacks an income: field (so the engine shows no amount), and its KIIP 5 is unsourced.
(3) F-5-14 survives the 2026-02-12 merger (2026.2 MOJ 동포 manual, annex 9) and covers F-4 converts. The 70% own-income figure (₩36,691,200) rests on leads. The data lacks an income: field and an F-4 → F-5-14 edge.
(4) Investor and family codes (F-5-5/17/19/21/22/25) and F-5-T1 have no income or KIIP test; the data matches, apart from small how-text points (F-5-19's 5 years are the investor's; F-5-25 also covers the family).
(5) Missing lang hints: F-5-3, F-5-27, F-5-29, F-5-S2 (basic knowledge is required, with minors exempt).

GNI multiples used (2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31): 0.5x 26,208,000; 0.7x 36,691,200; 0.8x 41,932,800; 1x 52,416,000. Nothing in /home/user/blog was modified.
